_doc: PHASE 35 (ADR-041 §12): which model role a task needs when nobody chose a model -- the rule in the catalog, not in the code. Each rule names a role and the word stems that call for it (matched at the start of a word, case and accents ignored as written). The role with the most stems found wins; equal counts go to the earlier rule, so the heavier roles come first: quality before speed. No stem found: defaultRole. Then the catalog's ACTIVE model of that role that the engine serves (its own role before one that also serves it); prefer 'smallest' picks the lightest of those. Without one, the roles of fallback, in order.
